<!-- pioneer-computer-use-migration-0.66.0 -->

## Breaking change: manual upgrade for older computer-use installations

**Computer-use installations below 0.66.0 require a manual upgrade, including
users who manage Pioneer only through Desktop.** Automatic updating from these
older CU installations is not supported by this release.

1. Fully quit Desktop.
2. Update Gateway **on the computer where Gateway is installed** with the
   appropriate command:

   macOS / Linux:

   ```bash
   curl -fsSL https://getpioneer.dev/install.sh | bash -s -- --computer-use
   ```

   Windows PowerShell:

   ```powershell
   $env:PIONEER_INSTALL_COMPUTER_USE="1"; iwr -useb https://getpioneer.dev/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

3. Then update Desktop separately from
   [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/pioneerdotai/pioneer/releases):

   - macOS: open the matching DMG and replace the application.
   - Windows: install the matching MSI.
   - Linux: replace the matching AppImage and give it executable permission.

Existing data and settings are preserved; do not delete or reset them.
Server/default installations keep their normal update procedure and do not
need computer-use enabled.
